page.content:
Princess Bubblegum's confectionery state.

How Candy Kingdom connects

  • Character: Princess Bubblegum — Princess Bubblegum rules the Candy Kingdom.
  • Location: Land of Ooo — The Candy Kingdom stands in the Land of Ooo.
  • Character: Peppermint Butler — Peppermint Butler serves the Candy Kingdom.
  • Faction: Banana Guards — The Banana Guards are the Candy Kingdom's watch.

What is Candy Kingdom?

The Candy Kingdom is the pink monarchy of candy people, banana guards, and Princess Bubblegum's science — Finn and Jake's most frequent ally-state.

Key threads lead to Princess Bubblegum, Land of Ooo, Peppermint Butler and Banana Guards.
